recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-7847 unless Pharmacy opens a separate issue to revisit reusable Dosage v2 mappings across all resource contexts.
issue_request: FHIR-7847 was a Published/Persuasive Pharmacy change request asking to blank the HL7 v2 mapping for MedicationStatement method, replacing RXR-4 Administration Method because MedicationStatement is a reported medication-use record rather than a v2 transaction concept.
initial_application: Historical commit 5bb461af1063efe577bac2b8b17b6992be7560bf applied a batch of MedicationDispense and MedicationStatement v2 mapping updates and removed the RXR-4-Administration Method cell from the old MedicationStatement.dosage.method spreadsheet row.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists MedicationStatement as an active resource. Current MedicationStatement.dosage is typed as DosageDetails and the old direct MedicationStatement.dosage.method mapping row no longer exists. Current MedicationStatement and DosageDetails source contains no RXR-4 mapping; the remaining RXR-4 mappings are in the reusable Dosage datatype and MedicationAdministration.dosage.method, which are outside this MedicationStatement-specific issue.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. Removing RXR-4 from reusable Dosage or MedicationAdministration would over-apply this tracker, while the authoritative MedicationStatement source already reflects the requested blank mapping.
